composites.name: millard_fba_bridge
composites.description:
v2ecoli-pdmp Phase 1 FBA-BRIDGE composite — couples the Millard 2017 kinetic
ODE (central carbon + energy metabolism, via pbg-copasi CopasiUTCProcess) with
v2ecoli's bulk store (via v2ecoli.steps.fba_bridge.FBABridge). Two solvers
in one PB composite, exchanging state at a documented seam.

STATUS: BRIDGE PROCESS BUILT + UNIT-TESTED. Standalone bridge works (see
tests/test_fba_bridge.py — 8 passing tests: mM<->count round-trip, mapping
load, direction modes, diagnostics). A coupled-pilot RUN of Millard + Bridge
reaches end-to-end (25 shared metabolites translated each step) but the
COPASI solver currently produces NaN at t=0.2s when the bridge fires before
Millard's first integration step. Open follow-up: ensure bridge interval >
Millard interval, or convert bridge from Step to Process with a defined
schedule. See planned_runs.millard-fba-bridge-pilot for the workaround.

Full coupling to v2ecoli's Metabolism process (the kFBA solver consuming the
bridge-translated bulk pool) remains DEFERRED — Metabolism requires the full
WCM context (cache, partition allocator, bulk loaders, unique stores) and is
a substantially larger lift than the bridge itself. The bridge is the
prerequisite; integration is the next Phase 1 milestone.

bridge_mapping.description: Millard <-> v2ecoli species name mapping (curated for ~25 shared central-carbon metabolites).

cell_volume_L.description: E. coli cell volume in liters used for mM <-> molecule-count conversion.

composites.name: millard_lqr
composites.description:
v2ecoli-pdmp Phase 1: Millard 2017 ODE + simplified scalar LQR outer
controller. The LQR drives a biomass-proxy growth-rate estimate toward
the Phase 0 M9-glucose reference μ(t) ensemble mean (real data from
64-replicate baseline).

Scope (proof of concept):
  - 1-state continuous-time LQR (closed-form Riccati solution for the
    scalar system ẋ = a x + b u)
  - Reads reference μ(t) from v2ecoli/data/phase0_glucose_mu_ref.npy
  - Computes tracking error + control signal per tick
  - LOGS the control signal (does NOT yet feed it back into Millard's
    reaction rates — closed-loop wiring is a follow-up; needs either a
    CopasiUTCProcess parameter-mutation feature OR a per-tick model
    rebuild wrapper)

This composite ships the LQR algebra + logging + Phase 0 reference
consumption. The `lqr-growth-rate-tracking` primary test in pdmp-01
can be evaluated against the logged tracking_err once the closed-loop
step is wired.

composites.name: millard2017_metabolism
composites.description:
Standalone Millard et al. 2017 kinetic ODE of E. coli central carbon and energy
metabolism (BioModels MODEL1505110000), wrapped as a process-bigraph composite
via pbg-copasi's CopasiUTCProcess. The model has 77 species, 68 reactions, 3
compartments. Baseline composite for the v2ecoli-pdmp Phase 1 study
(pdmp-01-metabolism-ode); first investigation-side use of pbg-copasi.

Calibrated reference state (per Millard 2017 Fig 2): K-12 MG1655 on M9
minimal medium + glucose, dilution rate 0.1 h^-1, pH 7.0, 37C, pO2 > 20%.
Steady-state should match the published reference fluxes within solver
tolerance.

model_source.description: Path to the Millard 2017 SBML (relative to workspace root).

time.description: Duration per process update in model time units (seconds).
